deviations.referenceBehavior: Reference kit includes its own print typography examples.
deviations.targetBehavior: Existing production report, hierarchy and Gantt print rules remain unchanged.
deviations.reason: The target has accepted A4/A3 templates, 14 pt report text and Segoe UI/Arial typography.

deviations.referenceBehavior: Reference implementation may use a component framework.
deviations.targetBehavior: Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript and existing Tauri IPC are retained.
deviations.reason: A framework migration is outside a visual adaptation and would add runtime and regression risk.

deviations.targetBehavior: The existing narrow card view is retained and themed.
deviations.reason: It preserves all fields and supports demonstrations on a phone-sized screen.

deviations.targetBehavior: Destructive and administrative actions remain visually and spatially separated.
deviations.reason: The production workflow requires explicit separation of routine and high-risk actions.
